text.body: || kṣurikopaniṣat || oṃ sahanāvavatu || saha nau bhunaktu || saha vīryaṃ karavāvahai || tejasvināvadhītamastu mā vidviṣāvahai || oṃ śāntiḥ śāntiḥ śāntiḥ || oṃ kṣurikāṃ sampravakṣyāmi dhāraṇāṃ yogasiddhaye | yaṃ prāpya na punarjanma yogayuktasya jāyate || 1 || vedatattvārthavihitaṃ yathoktaṃ hi svayambhuvā | niḥśabdaṃ deśamāsthāya tatrāsanamavasthitaḥ || 2 || kūrmo'ṅgānīva saṃhṛtya mano hṛdi nirudhya ca | mātrādvādaśayogena praṇavena śanaiḥ śanaiḥ || 3 || pūrayetsarvamātmānaṃ sarvadvāraṃ nirudhya ca | uromukhakaṭigrīvaṃ kiñcidbhūdayamunnatam || 4 || prāṇānsandhārayettasminnāsābhyantaracāriṇaḥ | bhūtvā tatra gataḥ prāṇaḥ śanairatha samutsṛjet || 5 || sthiramātrādṛḍhaṃ kṛtvā aṅguṣṭhena samāhitaḥ | dve gulphe tu prakurvīta jaṅghe caiva trayastrayaḥ || 6 || dve jānunī tathorubhyāṃ gude śiśne trayastrayaḥ | vāyorāyatanaṃ cātra nābhideśe samāśrayet || 7 || tatra nāḍī suṣumnā tu nāḍībhirbahubhirvṛtā | aṇuraktāśca pītāśca kṛṣṇāstāmravilohitāḥ || 8 || atisūkṣmāṃ ca tanvīṃ ca śuklāṃ nāḍīṃ samāśrayet | tatra sañcārayetprāṇānūrṇanābhīva tantunā || 9 || tato raktotpalābhāsaṃ hṛdayāyatanaṃ mahat | daharaṃ puṇḍarīkaṃ tadvedānteṣu nigadyate || 10 || tadbhittvā kaṇṭhamāyāti tāṃ nāḍīṃ pūrayanyataḥ | manasastu paraṃ guhyaṃ sutīkṣṇaṃ buddhinirmalam || 11 || pādasyopari yanmarma tadrūpaṃ nāma cintayet | manodvāreṇa tīkṣṇena yogamāśritya nityaśaḥ || 12 || indravajra iti proktaṃ marmajaṅghānukṛntanam | taddhyānabalayogena dhāraṇābhirnikṛntayet || 13 || ūrvormadhye tu saṃsthāpya marmaprāṇavimocanam | caturabhyāsayogena chindedanabhiśaṅkitaḥ || 14 || tataḥ kaṇṭhāntare yogī samūhannāḍisañcayam | ekottaraṃ nāḍiśataṃ tāsāṃ madhye parā sthirā || 15 || suṣumnā tu pare līnā virajā brahmarūpiṇī | iḍā tiṣṭhati vāmena piṅgalā dakṣiṇena ca || 16 || tayormadhye varaṃ sthānaṃ yastaṃ veda sa vedavit | dvāsaptatisahasrāṇi pratināḍīṣu taitilam || 17 || chindyate dhyānayogena suṣumnaikā na chidyate | yoganirmaladhāreṇa kṣureṇānalavarcasā || 18 || chindennāḍīśataṃ dhīraḥ prabhāvādiha janmani | jātīpuṣpasamāyogairyathā vāsyati taitilam || 19 || evaṃ śubhāśubhairbhāvaiḥ sā nāḍīti vibhāvayet | tadbhāvitāḥ prapadyante punarjanmavivarjitāḥ || 20 || tapovijitacittastu niḥśabdaṃ deśamāsthitaḥ | niḥsaṅgatattvayogajño nirapekṣaḥ śanaiḥ śanaiḥ || 21 || pāśaṃ chittvā yathā haṃso nirviśaṅkaṃ khamutkramet | chinnapāśastathā jīvaḥ saṃsāraṃ tarate sadā || 22 || yathā nirvāṇakāle tu dīpo dagdhvā layaṃ vrajet | tathā sarvāṇi karmāṇi yogī dagdhvā layaṃ vrajet || 23 || prāṇāyāmasutīkṣṇena mātrādhāreṇa yogavit | vairāgyopalaghṛṣṭena chittvā taṃ tu na badhyate || 24 || amṛtatvaṃ samāpnoti yadā kāmātsa mucyate | sarvaiṣaṇāvinirmuktaśchittvā taṃ tu na badhyata ityupaniṣat || 25 || oṃ saha nāvavatu || saha nau bhunaktu || saha vīryaṃ karavāvahai || tejasvināvadhītamastu mā vidviṣāvahai || oṃ śāntiḥ śāntiḥ śāntiḥ || || iti kṣurikopanuṣatsamāptā ||
